correctness.rationale: The exact period average gives Delta z=bT(h)(1-h); a periodic cohomological correction reduces the finite-b a=0 flow to a linear Kronecker flow on every regular energy torus. The positive-energy rotation function is strictly monotone by direct differentiation of the elliptic-integral representation. Dense irrational tori then force every continuous annular first integral to factor through H. Numerical integration agrees with the exact drift to about 1e-11.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The source contains the ingredients T(h), <cos y>=h/2 and C(h), but does not state the exact finite-b return map, global linearization, rational/irrational orbit classification, branch monodromy, or annular first-integral obstruction. Standard Kronecker-flow facts are excluded from novelty.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete global classification of the regular a=0 dynamics, an exact one-to-one resonance spectrum on positive energies, and resolves the distinction between local branchwise first integrals and globally single-valued integrability on the natural torus phase space.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
